title: Learning Outside the Classroom During a Pandemic: Evidence from an Artificial Intelligence-Based Education App
eligible_reason: Single adoption date. The treatment is living in the Daegu (DG) outbreak epicenter interacted with a common post period: analyses.do defines treat_post as 'user lives in the DG area and week is after the fourth week of Feb [2020]', and the event-study version uses lag_x/lead_x dummies relative to the single COVID-19 outbreak week (tid 38). All students are treated at the same calendar week, so the at-least-two-adoption-dates rule fails. Every column also includes time-varying weather controls (avg_temp, n_rain, n_snow). Data are not shipped (NDA exemption approved by the department editor).
design_notes: Student (uid) x week (tid) panel, 828,000 student-weeks (readme Table 2). Treatment group dg = 1 for students in the Daegu region; post = weeks from the fourth week of February 2020 (stage 1: tid 38-44 'learning loss', stage 2: tid >= 45 'learning recovery'). Table 3: xtreg y treat_post avg_temp n_rain n_snow i.tid, fe vce(robust) for y in {ln_search (quantity), div_index (pattern)}, for all students, high school (grade 10-12) and middle school (grade 7-9). Figure 4: xtreg y lag_* lead_* avg_temp n_rain n_snow i.tid, fe vce(robust) for ln_search, div_index, curri_index (pace). Figure 5 / Table 4: same leads-lags by school level with z-tests of coefficient equality. Student FE via xtset uid tid, week FE via i.tid, robust (not clustered) SEs.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One cohort: all DG-region students treated from the fourth week of February 2020 (COVID-19 outbreak in Daegu).

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date (common post period); time-varying weather controls
specs.treatment_definition: dg (lives in Daegu) x post (week >= fourth week of Feb 2020)
specs.sample_condition: all students; cols 2-3 restrict to grade 10-12 and grade 7-9
specs.reported_location: Table 3 (quantity panel, columns All / High / Middle)

specs.exclusion_reason: single adoption date; time-varying weather controls
specs.treatment_var: lag_* lead_* (weeks until / since the outbreak, DG students)
specs.treatment_definition: relative-week dummies around the single outbreak week
specs.sample_condition: all students (Figure 4); by school level (Figure 5, Table 4)

data_files_note: readme.docx: NDA with the collaborating company; exemption from the data policy approved. Only descriptive statistics (readme Tables 1-2 = paper Tables 2 and C.1) are provided. analyses.do expects data.dta, which is absent.
software_notes: Stata (xtreg fe, esttab, coefplot); session.pdf is the run log.
priority_note: Not eligible (single adoption date); data not shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text). Treatment timing confirmed from the variable definitions in the analyses.do header (lines 19-23) and the stage definitions at lines 37-39.
